meta.name: Power plants in India (WRI Global Power Plant Database v1.3)
meta.source_org: World Resources Institute (Global Power Plant Database)
meta.limitations: Capacity data is from about 2018-2019. Plants that open later are missing. Some fuel types (solar, wind) have low coverage of small plants. Coordinates of some plants have low precision.
meta.method: Filter country == IND. Keep rows with coordinates inside India's bounding box. State from point-in-polygon on data/raw boundaries (nearest state within 0.25 degrees for coastal points). Capacity stays in MW.
